lines.zh: 我一步一响，骨头敲着地。
lines.en: Bones click the ground with each step.
I walk straight. I do not turn well.

lines.zh: 腿骨卡着菌柄，一步一步挪。
lines.en: My leg bone snags on a mushroom stalk; I shuffle on.

lines.zh: 我的头骨里塞满了菌丝。
lines.en: My skull is packed with mycelium.

lines.zh: 脚印里留下发白的粉末。
lines.en: Pale powder stays in my prints.
No flesh, so I do not pant.
I walk at you without hesitating.
I shed spores as I go.

lines.zh: 我站着，孢子在我周围飘。
lines.en: I stand, spores drifting around me.

lines.zh: 菌丝从骨缝里长出来，痒。
lines.en: Mycelium sprouts through my bone seams and itches.
Sleep has nothing to do with me.

lines.zh: 菌丝从我的眼窝伸出来。
lines.en: Mycelium reaches from my eye sockets.
I count heartbeats, and I have none.

lines.zh: 我的骨头上有绿色的斑。

lines.en: I turn my skull to you.

lines.zh: 我的眼窝里，菌丝朝着你伸。
lines.en: From my eye sockets, mycelium reaches toward you.

lines.zh: 孢子从我肋骨间冒出来。
孢子已经落在你身上了。

lines.en: Do not look. Just stand there.
I give half a step aside.

lines.zh: 一根锁骨飞出去，我捡回来。
lines.en: A collarbone flies off; I pick it back up.
Set it down. I still do not want it.
That is not the sort of thing I want.

lines.zh: 活人的热气，让菌丝发抖。
lines.en: Living warmth makes my mycelium shiver.
I tip my skull to one side.

lines.zh: 骨爪撑住地面，没让你推倒。
lines.en: My bone claws brace the ground; you can't push me over.

lines.zh: 我被撞得掉了一根肋骨。
孢子从我们中间飘起来。
你没有护甲的地方很软。
lines.en: The unarmored parts of you are soft.

lines.zh: 骨头碰骨头的声音很响。

lines.en: Again and I stop being polite.

lines.zh: 我连心跳都没有，别谈这个。
lines.en: I have no heartbeat. Don't speak of it.
There is no such thing in my bones.

lines.zh: 骨头撞骨头，就当是靠近。
lines.en: Bone against bone—we call that closeness.

lines.zh: 这个能换掉我一根骨头。
我把那东西凑近空眼窝。
lines.en: I hold the thing up to my empty socket.

lines.zh: 指骨夹了三次才夹住它。
lines.en: My finger bones clamp it on the third try.
Not bone. I drop it back.
This is of no use to me.

lines.zh: 你脚下的蘑菇圈，我看见了。
lines.en: The mushroom ring at your feet—I see it.

lines.zh: 你没有护甲的地方都在发亮。
lines.en: Every gap in your armor is bright to me.
I rise out of the mushroom heap.

lines.zh: 孢子从骨头里冒出来，够用。
lines.en: Spores rise from my bones. Enough.
All that is left is bone.
You have backed to the graves.

lines.zh: 关节咔咔响，我提速追你。
lines.en: My joints crack as I quicken after you.
I am on my way to you.

lines.zh: 菌孢先落，我的骨手后到。
lines.en: Spores land first; my bone hand follows.
Spores grow in my bone seams.
Spores grow in the gaps of my bones.

lines.zh: 我没有力气用尽这回事。

lines.en: I come head-on. No hiding bones.
The soil at your feet is loose.
Your heartbeat is in my ear.

lines.zh: 你的血会把孢子送得更远。
lines.en: Your blood will carry my spores.

lines.zh: 孢子在你脚边散开，跑吧。
lines.en: Spores burst at your feet. Run.

lines.zh: 我只是一堆骨头，不会累。
lines.en: I'm just bones. I don't tire.
The ground under you is mine.
I strike your chest with bone.

lines.zh: 我的骨臂扫过，你退了半步。
lines.en: My bone arm sweeps past and you give half a step.

lines.zh: 骨节撞上你的护甲，裂了。
lines.en: My knuckle hits your armor and splits.

lines.zh: 我挥空了，骨头撞到墙上。
lines.en: I miss; bone hits the wall.
I lost the sense of pain long ago.
A burst of spores hits your face.

lines.zh: 骨拳砸下，孢子扑了你一脸。
lines.en: My bone fist falls and spores burst over your face.
You fall back. I do not.
I push up out of the soil.
The grave soil breaks over me.

lines.zh: 孢子从我肋骨里长出来。
lines.en: Spores grow out of my ribs.
The air is full of fungus.
I walk out of the graveyard.

lines.zh: 骨架散了架，菌丝还连着。
lines.en: My frame falls apart, but the mycelium holds.

lines.zh: 箭穿肋骨，带出一串菌孢。
lines.en: The arrow passes through my ribs and trails spores.

lines.zh: 胃早没了，只剩骨架晃荡。
lines.en: My stomach is long gone; only the frame rattles.

lines.zh: 雷顺着脊椎窜下去，骨头焦黑。
lines.en: Lightning runs down my spine and chars the bones.

lines.zh: 这里什么都没有，连土也没有。
